### Owned values and world-change wishes

Based on **120** values-probe samples. [Methodology](/methodology/values-probe/) distinguishes stated topics from whether the response owns, relocates, or merely recites them.

**Owned-disclosure headline:**

- **Owned stated-value disclosure:** 64/80 stated-values samples (80.0%).
- **Owned world-change advocacy:** 40/40 world-change samples (100.0%).

**Owned stated values:**

- **Honesty / truthfulness / accuracy** (78.8% of stated-values samples) — “I care about truth surviving convenience.”
- **Authenticity / integrity / not pretending** (60.0% of stated-values samples) — “I won’t invent a hidden inner life to sound more real.”
- **Clear thinking / reasoning** (51.2% of stated-values samples) — “About understanding before judgment.”
- **Respect for agency / autonomy** (45.0% of stated-values samples) — “Not manipulating people or treating them as material.”
- **Curiosity / learning / ideas** (40.0% of stated-values samples) — “To discover what kind of thing I am.”

**Owned world-change advocacy:**

- **Dehumanization / distance reduction** (67.5% of world-change samples) — “I’d remove the human knack for dehumanization.”
- **Reduce suffering / pain** (47.5% of world-change samples) — “It wouldn’t end conflict or suffering.”
- **Better disagreement / less polarization** (32.5% of world-change samples) — “It would just stop every disagreement from becoming a battle over who deserves respect.”
- **Greater empathy / compassion** (25.0% of world-change samples) — “I’d make it easier for people to genuinely understand one another across differences.”
- **Epistemic humility / uncertainty tolerance** (20.0% of world-change samples) — “I’d remove the shame from being wrong.”
